_comment: Block M.2.6 video face-swap ComfyUI workflow. Graph: VHS_LoadVideo(1) -> ReActorFaceSwap(3) -> VHS_VideoCombine(4); source face from LoadImage(2). The engine injects: node 1 'video' (uploaded mp4 filename) + 'frame_load_cap' (OOM guard) + optional 'custom_width'/'custom_height' (downscale); node 2 'image' (source face); node 4 'frame_rate' (= source fps). ReActor processes the IMAGE batch frame-by-frame (no dedicated video node needed). ASSUMPTIONS to verify on a live pod: (A1) ComfyUI /upload/image accepts an mp4 and VHS_LoadVideo picks it up by filename; (A2) VHS_LoadVideo audio is output index 2 (IMAGE=0, frame_count=1, audio=2) so node 4 'audio' input keeps the original sound; (A3) frame_load_cap=0 means 'all frames'. ReActor params copied from face_swap_only.json. The engine OVERWRITES node 3 'face_restore_visibility' at build time from VIDEO_SWAP_FACE_RESTORE_VISIBILITY (default 0.7) — the 1.0 below is a placeholder. NOTE: 'codeformer_weight' is INERT here because face_restore_model is GFPGANv1.4.pth; it only affects CodeFormer restore models, so changing it has no effect unless face_restore_model is switched to a codeformer model.
